blocks.text: Harvesters fill their holds at rocks, gas giants and nebulae, then haul the load home.
blocks.title: Harvesting

blocks.text: A small rock holds the same amount whether it is minerals or spice, and so does a large one, on every map.
blocks.title: Asteroid sizes

blocks.text: A spice nebula is made of glowing pixels.
blocks.title: Spice nebulae

blocks.text: A working Power Plant burns minerals instead of energy, so it never shuts down.
blocks.title: Power Plant fuel

blocks.text: Every ship, construct and working building costs energy each minute.
blocks.title: Upkeep

blocks.text: Run short of energy and things shut down; run out of everything and you're eliminated.
blocks.title: Brownout and Blackout

blocks.text: Spice pays any food, mineral or energy shortfall, unless you switch it off.
blocks.title: Spice cover

blocks.text: The resource bar shows each stockpile and its net change per minute (green rising, red falling).
blocks.title: Net per minute
